statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal of Viet Nam (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) operated by the Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be in Vietnamese script (Romanized Vietnamese) and may include letters c, ă, â, đ, e, ê, i, o, ô, ơ, u, ư, y, etc. and digits; must be pronounceable and consist of at least two words where the first word must be a company type designation (e.g., CÔNG TY TNHH or CÔNG TY TRÁCH NHIỆM HỮU HẠN). A foreign investor may add a foreign-language name (e.g., English) that satisfies the name rules, but the Vietnamese name remains the legal name. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and must not violate intellectual property rights, traditional/cultural norms, or public order. Foreign words in the Vietnamese name must be transliterated into Vietnamese syllables; uppercase/lowercase and tone marks are governed by the Law on Enterprises and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered business name in the national database
National symbols, flags, emblems, images of the State and of Viet Nam
Political organizations, state enterprises, social-political organizations' names without authorization
Names of state agencies, units of the armed forces, People's Public Security forces
Terms implying government, national sovereignty, or state monopoly such as 'Chính phủ', 'Nhà nước', 'Quốc hội', 'Bộ Công an' without ministerial approval
Profane, discriminatory, or procurement-sensitive words contrary to Vietnamese traditional culture, history, national identity, or fine customs
Words that infringe upon industrial property rights
The token 'UN' unless expressly authorized by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and relevant UN body as an organizational reference (sensitive due to intergovernmental convention)
The token 'Battery Safety' if combined in a way that suggests certification accreditation by a national authority without licensing approval
The token 'Testing' / 'Lab' without the required statutory license under Decree No. 109/2020/ND-CP (Conformity Assessment activities) or applicable Ministry of Science and Technology licensing
Tokens such as 'Bank', 'Insurance', 'Trust', 'Fund' unless licensed under special law
Foreign words that do not comply with Vietnamese transliteration rules
Names that are misleading about the enterprise's legal form or capable of deceiving customers
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed company name, the applicant may submit a new name registration or file a written request for reconsideration to the Business Registration Office within 10 working days. If the rejection is based on a decision of the Director of the Business Registration Office, the applicant may appeal to the Director General of the Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment pursuant to Articles 20-24 of Decree 122/2021/ND-CP and the Law on Handling of Administrative Petitions No. 02/2011/QH13. The appeal must include the business registration dossier, the rejection notice, legal grounds, and proposed alternative names. The processing time for reconsideration is 10 working days from receipt, extendable once for 10 working days in complex cases. Judicial review under Law on Administrative Procedure No. 06/2015/QH13 is available after exhaustion of administrative remedies.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Generally not permissible for a testing laboratory engaged in dangerous goods UN38.3 testing. The Law on Enterprises and Decree 01/2021/ND-CP require the registered office to be a physical, identifiable address in Viet Nam with a permanent address receiving official correspondence. Additionally, the Ministry of Transport / Ministry of Science and Technology conformity-assessment licensing regime for a battery safety testing laboratory will require physical laboratory premises, installed test equipment, qualified technical personnel, and an on-site safety management system. A pure virtual office with no physical lab presence would fail the statutory licensing test under Decree No. 109/2020/ND-CP and ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation requirements.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 5, 24-25, 46-56, 76-78, 203); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 33, 36, 38-39, 66); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (Articles 4-31, Forms I-1 through I-13); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP guiding the Law on Investment (Articles 36-44, Form A); Circular No. 02/2019/TT-BKHDT on enterprise registration data; Law on Corporate Income Tax No. 14/2008/QH12 as amended for post-formation registration obligations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Agency for Business Registration of the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) operating through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) together with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) one-stop window located at the province or centrally managed city where the registered office will be established.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giay de nghi dang ky doanh nghiep) executed on Form I-1 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, accompanied by the Company Charter, List of Legal Representatives (Form I-2), List of Founding Members (Form I-3), List of Member Legal Representatives (Form I-4), and the notarized office lease and supporting dossiers as prescribed by Articles 21-27 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Vietnam imposes no economy-wide statutory minimum paid-up capital for an LLC engaged in technical testing and analysis (ISIC 7120). However, the foreign-invested company must declare a Charter Capital fully subscribed in the Charter and sufficient for the scale of the project, which is a substantive appraisal criterion in the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) proceeding under Article 36 of the Law on Investment. The contributed capital, either in cash or appraised non-cash assets, must be fully paid within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Article 47.4 of the Law on Enterprises); cash contributions must be deposited into a dedicated escrow/transaction capital account at a bank licensed in Vietnam, and the legal representative is required to report capital contribution and account statements to the DPI. If the contributory capital remains unpaid, the LLC must undergo a capital adjustment or capital reduction procedure and the legal representative is subject to administrative sanctions under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING MEMBER OF [LEGAL NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (HEREINAFTER THE 'COMPANY')

WHEREAS:
(1) The Founding Member has applied for, or intends to apply for, an Investment Registration Certificate and the incorporation of the Company as a foreign-invested single-member limited liability company under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14;
(2) The draft Company Charter (the 'Charter') and incorporation dossier dated [DATE] have been reviewed and approved;
(3) The Company will operate under ISIC 7120 (Technical Testing and Analysis) as a Dangerous Goods UN38.3 battery safety and CE-RED electromagnetic testing laboratory, a conditional business line requiring statutory licenses, environmental permits and ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation;

NOW, THEREFORE, THE FOUNDING MEMBER HEREBY RESOLVES AS FOLLOWS:

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The Founding Member subscribes for one hundred percent (100%) of the Charter Capital of the Company, fixed at VND [AMOUNT] (or foreign currency equivalent), being not less than the registered investment capital stated in IRC No. [NUMBER] dated [DATE]. The full subscribed capital shall be contributed in cash or lawful non-cash assets within ninety (90) days following issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. All cash contributions shall be remitted into an escrow/capital account opened by the Company at a bank licensed in Vietnam, and evidence of contribution shall be filed with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment in accordance with Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises.

2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office of the Company within the meaning of Article 48 of the Law on Enterprises is hereby fixed at [FULL ADDRESS], Ward [WARD], District [DISTRICT], [PROVINCE/CENTRALLY RUN CITY], Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The Founding Member ratifies the notarized office lease agreement executed as of [DATE] with [LESSOR], subject to verification that the premises has been completed, registered with the land authority and legally leased under the Law on Real Estate Business and relevant construction regulations.

3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS. The Founding Member hereby appoints:
(a) [FULL NAME], passport number [PASSPORT], resident at [ADDRESS], as Chairperson-cum-General Director and sole legal representative of the Company, with authority to represent the Company before the National Business Registration Information System, tax authorities, courts and third parties; and
(b) [FULL NAME], passport number [PASSPORT], as Deputy Director (and second authorized signatory) and, where required, Members of the Supervisory Committee are appointed as set out in the Charter.
The appointments shall take full force upon the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

4. BANKING AND SIGNING AUTHORITY. The Founding Member authorizes the General Director to open the Company's payment account and the statutory escrow/capital contribution account at a bank licensed in Vietnam, and to register the corporate seal specimen on the National Business Registration Portal in accordance with Article 36 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP. Authorized signatories for banking purposes shall be the General Director and the Chief Accountant, or their written delegates.

5. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION. The General Director (and in his/her absence the Deputy Director) is irrevocably authorized to execute, file, sign and deliver any and all instruments, notices and declarations, including the Enterprise Registration Application (Form I-1), tax registration forms, investment adjustment applications, labor registration forms, environmental license applications, ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation applications, UN38.3 testing laboratory designation documents, and to pay applicable state fees, in order to carry this Resolution into full effect.

6. EFFECTIVENESS. This Resolution is adopted on [DATE] and remains effective until revoked by a subsequent resolution of the Founding Member. The Secretary or the General Director shall produce a certified copy of this Resolution for filing with the competent authorities.

RESOLVED AND APPROVED at [CITY] on [DATE] by
[FOUNDING MEMBER NAME]
Signature and seal: ______________________
Full Name: ______________________
Title: Founding Member / Authorized Representative

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application and appraisal for the foreign-invested project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) - Foreign Investment Registration One-Stop Division, via the National Foreign Investment Information System (through the official online portal or in-person counter at the DPI headquarters of the intended province)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor prepares and signs the Application for Investment Project Registration under Form A of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP, together with a written resolution approving the project, the draft Company Charter, evidence of financial capacity (bank-issued balance confirmation, audited financial statements or parent corporate guarantee), and a notarized memorandum of intent or conditioned lease for the future registered office. The dossier is submitted via the online National Foreign Investment Information System. The DPI, within 3 working days of receipt, reviews completeness; once complete, the DPI conducts appraisal and consults line ministries only if the business line is on the conditional market-access list. No conditional market access applies to technical testing, but the DPI will verify project compatibility with the approved master plan and the investor's legal capacity. The DPI issues the IRC within 15 days from the date of complete dossier acceptance, simultaneously validating the foreign investor's 100% ownership of the LLC.
required_dossiers: Application for investment project registration (Form A, signed by the investor)
Written resolution or decision of the investor approving the project and capital amount
Company Charter draft (current version to be finalized at ERC stage)
Legal identity of foreign investor: passport or certificate of incorporation, apostilled/legalized with notarized Vietnamese translation
Financial capacity statement: bank balance certificate, audited financial statements or parent company guarantee letter
Notarized office lease memorandum of intent or conditioned lease agreement with the building owner
Power of attorney and passport of the authorized signatory if the investor appoints a proxy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written request for amendment or clarification under Article 36.4 of the Law on Investment, the investor has 30 days to supplement the dossier; failing to respond triggers a summary refusal. Upon refusal, the applicant may file a complaint with the Minister of Planning and Investment or initiate administrative court proceedings within 30 days from receipt of the refusal, and may re-submit a revised application once the grounds for refusal are cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution, notarization and certification of constitutive documents and location agreements
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Notary Office (Phong Cong chung) located within the province of the proposed registered office; Vietnamese consular/legalization authorities outside Vietnam for foreign-issued documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following issuance of the IRC, the investor finalizes and signs the Company Charter providing for a single-member LLC, returns of the legal representative consent and the notarized office lease. The office lease must be executed on a premises that has been completed and registered under the Law on Real Estate Business No. 65/2014/QH13; the lessor must provide certified copies of the Certificate of Land Use Rights and Ownership of House, the as-built approval, or the sale-and-lease eligibility certificate. The notary verifies the legal standing of the parties, the clarity of the lease term (minimum term of 3 years is market standard and recommended for subsequent labor and stability evidence), the charter subscription and the identity of the legal representative. The notarized dossier, in duplicate, is sealed and stamped, and certified Vietnamese translations are appended to any foreign-issued identity documents.
required_dossiers: Final Company Charter (signed by the Founding Member)
Notarized office lease agreement (minimum 3-year term) and the lessor's Certificate of Land Use Rights and Ownership of House or equivalent
Notarized copies of passport or certificate of incorporation of the Founding Member and the appointed legal representative
Consent letter of the appointed legal representative and appointment decision
IRC certificate (certified copy)
Power of attorney authorizing a representative to execute the charter if execution is not done in person
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary refuses to certify due to defective title or unregistered premises, the investor must cure the defect by obtaining a lawful lease grant, using a different licensed building, or submitting a substitute leasehold with full title documents. If correction is impossible, the lease must be replaced and the IRC filing location remains valid as long as the address is in the same province.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Enterprise Registration Application and issuance of Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) administered by the Agency for Business Registration of MPI, with fallback filing at the DPI one-stop window of the registered province
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The legal representative logs on to the National Business Registration Portal using a digital certificate or e-ID, completes the online Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1), attaches the final Charter, list of legal representatives (Form I-2), list of founding members (Form I-3) and list of member's legal representatives (Form I-4) where applicable, and uploads scanned notarized copies of the office lease, IRC and identity documents. The system assesses the electronic fee of VND 50,000 (approximately USD 2.10). Within 3 working days from receipt of a complete application, the DPI issues the ERC with the enterprise code, tax code and registered name, which automatically registers the Company with the national tax file. On issuance, the Company's legal status is effective and the Company must publicize its registration on the National Business Registration Portal within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1)
Company Charter (final, signed in accordance with the notarial practice)
List of Legal Representatives (Form I-2) with identity copies
List of Founding Members (Form I-3)
List of Member's Legal Representatives (Form I-4) if the founding member is an organization
Notarized office lease agreement and lessor title evidence
Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for the foreign investment project
Passport/identity documents of the legal representative and founding member (legalized and translated)
Receipt of payment of the state registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI returns a written notice with defects, the applicant must correct and resubmit within 10 working days; the DPI must issue the ERC within 3 working days of the corrected submission. If the DPI issues a refusal, the applicant may appeal to the Minister of Planning and Investment, or initiate administrative proceedings before the competent People's Court within 30 days. Unjustified delay beyond the statutory period may be further complained to the Provincial People's Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Charter capital contribution and establishment of the escrow/capital transaction account at a licensed bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks in Vietnam (e.g. Vietcombank, BIDV, Techcombank, HSBC Vietnam) or a bank with a valid establishment license in Vietnam; reporting to DPI via the National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 90 days from the ERC issuance, the Founding Member must transfer the full Charter Capital into the Company's escrow/capital transaction account opened at a licensed bank in Vietnam. The Director opens the account in the name of the LLC presenting the ERC, IRC, Charter, seal, and banking resolution of the legal representative. Cash contributions may be received via international wire in foreign currency or VND; the bank issues an account balance certificate reflecting the deposit. The Company must simultaneously file the capital contribution receipt and proof of payment to the DPI using the statutory reporting form on the National Business Registration Portal. If capital is contributed in kind, the non-cash assets must be appraised by a licensed valuation firm, and the transfer documents must evidence the receipt by value. The escrow account remains the operating transaction account thereafter; any return of contributed capital to the member before completion of the 90-day period is prohibited by Article 47.2 of the Law on Enterprises.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (original)
Investment Registration Certificate
Company Charter and seal specimen
Bank account opening application and client due diligence forms
Resolution or authorization of the legal representative for opening the account
Passport of the legal representative and chief accountant
Capital contribution schedule and wire transfer instruction
Non-cash contribution appraisal report and transfer documents (if in-kind contribution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to fully contribute within 90 days triggers mandatory adjustment of the Charter Capital to the actually contributed amount; the unpaid portion must be either cancelled by aminority capital reduction procedure or reassigned, with administrative penalty of up to VND 40,000,000 (approximately USD 1,660) for the legal representative under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP. The equitable remedy is to make the contribution immediately, file the capital receipt report to DPI, and pay any late contributions alongside an official explanation; if the delay is prolonged, the Company must file a charter amendment reducing capital and re-register the new capital level.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation seal, tax, labor, email and operational registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Public Security (Công an tinh) for seal issuance; local Tax Sub-department under GDT via the electronic portal for tax and e-invoice registration; Vietnam Social Insurance agency for social insurance; Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs for labor registration; General Department of Taxation for e-invoice activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately following ERC issuance, the legal representative publishes the corporate seal specimen and declares the availability of the seal on the National Business Registration Portal. The Company files the initial tax registration, including the appointment of the Chief Accountant, and registers for value-added tax (VAT) under the flat 10% VAT regime and corporate income tax declarations (quarterly provisional). All newly active companies must obtain a digital signature for e-invoice issuance, register e-invoices with the tax authority and apply for certificate of electronic transaction code with the tax office. Labor obligations are triggered: the Company must declare labor usage with DOLISA, open a social insurance account (BHXH) within 30 days of hiring the first employee, and register a labor contract template and internal labor regulation if employing 10 or more employees. The LLC must also notify the DPI of the completion of capital contribution. Regulatory announcements of company status on the National Portal must be completed within 30 days of ERC issuance, and the Company must execute a stamped declaration of available postal/bank channel for the company's transaction activities.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and IRC (certified copies)
Company Charter and seal specimen declaration form
Form 01-DK-TCT (tax registration application) and Form 05-MST
Electronic signature certificate application (chữ ky so) from the tax authority
List of employees and labor contract templates
Social insurance registration forms (TK1-TS, TK2-TS)
Appointment of Chief Accountant (if the Director is not also the accountant)
Corporate seal specimen registration to the National Business Registration Portal
Power of attorney for tax and labor representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration of tax, e-invoice, labor and social insurance exposes the Company to administrative fines and late payment surcharges under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP and Decree 12/2022/ND-CP. The remedy is immediate filing of the unfinished declarations with reasonable explanation; penalties for first-time minor defaults may be reduced at the inspector's discretion. If the seal specimen is rejected, the Company must re-submit corrected specimen drawings; if social insurance registration is delayed, the Company must pay all accrued employee contributions with interest and may negotiate an installment plan with the Social Insurance Agency.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Science and Technology (MOST) - Directorate for Standards, Metrology and Quality (STAMEQ); Vietnam Bureau of Accreditation (BoA/VNCNAS) for laboratory accreditation; Department of Technical and Safety and Certification of Conformity under MOST for conditional technical testing and conformity assessment operations; Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) for electrical equipment and battery safety matters relevant to UN38.3 and CE-RED certifications
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Technical Testing Service Operation Certificate - Certificate of registration for technical testing service activities (Giay dang ky hoat dong dich vu ky thuat) issued by MOST under Decree No. 13/2022/ND-CP on technical testing and inspection; supplemented by ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Laboratory Accreditation Certificate issued by BoA/VNCNAS covering UN 38.3 dangerous goods testing and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) test methods; and, where the laboratory issues conformity certificates for regulated products, the Certificate of Recognized Testing Organization under Decree No. 74/2018/ND-CP as amended.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) through the Environmental Licensing Department; provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) acting as the Environmental Protection Agency for projects of provincial significance; commune-level environmental authority for the lowest-tier environmental registration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II/III - Environmental Registration or Environmental License: a laboratory engaged in battery drop testing and electromagnetic testing is not on the mandatory Full EIA Report (Category I) list of Annex IV of Decree 08/2022/ND-CP, but the generation of hazardous waste such as damaged or wet-cell batteries, spent electrolyte, heavy metal residues and waste electrical/electronic equipment requires classification under Category III, warranting an Environmental License issued by DONRE where the project operates manufacturing or discharge facilities, or, where waste volumes remain below the thresholds of Decree 08/2022/ND-CP, a Commune-Level Environmental Registration Certificate (Sổ dang ky moi truong). A full EIA is not required unless the laboratory adds dedicated battery recycling, thermal processes, electroplating lines or storage of hazardous substances in volumes exceeding the thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater must meet QCVN 40:2011/BTNMT national technical regulation on industrial wastewater (BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L, COD not exceeding 75 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L, pH within 6-9, cyanide below 0.07 mg/L, lead below 0.1 mg/L, nickel below 0.5 mg/L); ambient air quality inside and perimeter of the laboratory must not exceed QCVN 05:2023/BTNMT for TSP, SO2, NO2 and O3; emission from any standby diesel generators must comply with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT on industrial emissions (dust not exceeding 200 mg/Nm3, SO2 not exceeding 500 mg/Nm3); hazardous waste storage must comply with Circular 02/2022/TT-BTNMT including a hazardous waste storage room with sealed containment trays, labeling, and a 3-day notification to the provincial environmental authority for any accidental release; spent batteries, electrical components and chemical waste must be transferred only to licensed hazardous waste treatment facilities, and floor drainage from the drop-test area must be separated and treated as hazardous wastewater characterized by UN38.3 test residues.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier_additional_note: The laboratory must prepare an environmental impact assessment mitigation plan even for a Category III license, and must conduct quarterly emission self-monitoring if total wastewater discharge exceeds 25 m3/day or if the laboratory uses batteries as raw materials in quantities above the threshold of Annex VIII of Decree 08/2022/ND-CP.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The laboratory must obtain Fire Prevention and Fighting Police approval - Certificate of Fire Safety Design Approval and Certificate of Acceptance of Completion of Fire Safety Works (Giay chung nhan tham duyet thiet ke PCCC va Giay xac nhan nghiem thu ve PCCC) issued by the Provincial Police Department under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP, covering electromagnetic testing chambers and battery storage cells with adequate fire suppression and VOC detection systems; structural load and as-built verification must be evidenced by a construction completion certificate or a certificate of eligibility for house ownership under the Law on Construction No. 50/2014/QH13; electrical installation must be inspected by an accredited body to confirm compliance with QCVN 01:2021/BXD on construction safety and electrical system safety; workplace environment monitoring (noise, vibration, electromagnetic field exposure, chemical vapors) must comply with QCVN 24:2016/BYT for health and safety, and occupational hygiene registration must be filed with the Department of Health under Law No. 84/2015/QH13 on Occupational Safety and Hygiene; an Internal Labor Regulation must be registered with the provincial labor authority if the laboratory employs 10 or more persons; employees performing UN38.3 drop tests must receive dangerous goods transport safety (IMDG/UN) training certification and first aid training; all testing equipment must be calibrated and traceable to national or international standards as required by ISO/IEC 17025.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam (Tổng cục Thuế, GDT) under the Ministry of Finance; national e-tax filing and registration portal: eTax system at thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; national e-invoice portal: hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; enterprise registration is separately administered by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment through the National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: For a foreign-invested LLC, obtain the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment; the 10-digit Enterprise Code issued on the ERC automatically constitutes the statutory tax identification number (TIN) under Law on Enterprises 2020 Art. 29 and Circular 105/2020/TT-BTC, so no separate TIN application is required. Step 2: Within 10 working days of ERC issuance, complete and submit the initial tax registration dossier, including the VAT method election (credit versus direct method), legal representative, location, and business line (ISIC 7120 / testing services), through the eTax portal thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; the GDT issues the electronic TIN certificate and taxpayer profile. Step 3: Register a certified digital signature (CA) and create the e-invoice account on hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; register e-invoice templates and obtain GDT approval before first use. Step 4: Open a Vietnamese authorized-bank account for foreign-currency export proceeds, register payroll and social insurance, and set the VAT filing period (monthly or quarterly) with the competent tax sub-department. A foreign investor may also appoint a licensed tax agent to perform the registration; all filings are digital and no physical inspection is required at the registration stage.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the Vietnam LLC is a resident corporate taxpayer under Law on Corporate Income Tax 14/2008/QH12 (as amended) and is taxed on worldwide taxable income at the standard 20% CIT rate. There is no pass-through or fiscal-transparency regime in Vietnamese law; profits are taxed at the LLC level and distributions to foreign shareholders are not subject to any dividend withholding or profit-remittance tax (the former profits remittance tax is repealed). Territorial nuance: a resident LLC is taxed on worldwide income, while non-resident foreign contractors are taxed only on Vietnam-source income. No general tax-exempt-zone status applies to the LLC itself; a services-oriented laboratory would need an EPE or industrial-zone incentive certificate to access special regimes, and battery-safety testing services rarely satisfy EPE manufacturing/processing conditions under Decree 82/2018/ND-CP.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnamese law does not operate a United States-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election. The elections and regimes which a foreign-invested testing LLC may validly invoke include: (1) VAT credit (deduction) method election at tax registration, mandatory for businesses with annual revenue from VND 1 billion, and voluntary below that threshold; (2) direct VAT method election where the quantitative thresholds are met; (3) CIT incentive election for a new investment project certified in an eligible industrial zone, high-tech zone, or supporting-industry project, which may confer a 10% preferential CIT rate for 15 years, a 4-year CIT exemption and 50% CIT reduction for the following 9 years (Law on CIT Arts. 13-16; Decree 218/2013/ND-CP), provided the IRC records the incentive conditions; (4) global minimum tax registration and top-up tax filing for MNE groups meeting the EUR 750 million consolidated revenue threshold under Resolution 107/2023/QH15 (effective fiscal year 2024); (5) after the first 12 months of compliant operation, election to migrate from tax-authority-coded e-invoices to self-issued e-invoices (Decree 123/2020/ND-CP); (6) foreign contractor tax withholding election and qualified intermediary registration for cross-border payments; and (7) VAT refund election for zero-rated exporters on a monthly or quarterly basis. Hybrid mismatch elections (e.g., dual consolidated loss elections) are not recognized; Vietnam instead applies controlled-foreign-company rules under Circular 96/2015/TT-BTC to re-attribute low-taxed offshore profits.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Thuế Giá trị Gia tăng - GTGT), governed by Law on VAT 13/2008/QH13 as amended by Laws 31/2013/QH13 and 106/2016/QH13, Decree 209/2013/ND-CP, Decree 176/2016/ND-CP, Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC and Circular 40/2021/TT-BTC, together with Government decrees implementing the temporary 8% reduced rate for specified goods and services during 2024-2025.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no VAT registration threshold for an LLC: VAT registration is mandatory from the date the ERC/TIN is issued. The operative monetary thresholds are: (i) VND 1,000,000,000 of annual revenue from the sale of goods or services, at or above which the VAT credit (deduction) method is compulsory and below which the direct method applies unless voluntary credit-method registration is elected (Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC Art. 12); and (ii) VND 100,000,000 of annual revenue, which is the simplified compulsory registration threshold applicable only to household and casual businesses, not to corporate LLCs. For foreign contractors supplying cross-border services into Vietnam, the VND 1 billion threshold also governs the option to register for the deduction method; otherwise foreign contractor tax applies by withholding.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing applies to all enterprises from 1 July 2022 (Decree 123/2020/ND-CP; Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC). A newly established foreign-invested LLC must use e-invoices with a tax-authority code for the first 12 months of operation: each XML invoice is transmitted to GDT in real time via API or portal web service, and GDT clears the invoice by returning a unique tax-authority code (mã của cơ quan thuế) before the invoice is legally valid, which functions as a real-time digital fiscal stamp. After 12 months of compliance, the LLC may apply to issue self-issued e-invoices without a pre-approved code; such invoices must still bear a digital signature from a licensed certification authority (CA) and a QR code, and the full invoice data must be transmitted to the hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn portal no later than the statutory due date of the VAT filing period in which the invoice was issued, with an accelerated 2-hour transmission rule for certain categories of supplies. There is no physical fiscal-printer or paper-stamping regime; the tax-authority code, QR code, and GDT data repository constitute the fiscal clearance and audit trail. All e-invoice templates must be pre-registered and approved by GDT, and invoices must be issued in Vietnamese (with English allowed for exported services).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Law on VAT Art. 9 and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC Art. 9, zero-rating (0% VAT) requires, cumulatively: (1) the supply is an export of goods or a service rendered directly to a foreign organization or individual; (2) for services, the service is consumed outside Vietnam, meaning the economic benefit and the test report are used offshore; (3) the foreign party is invoiced with a valid 0% VAT e-invoice; and (4) payment is received from abroad in convertible foreign currency credited to a Vietnamese authorized bank account (bank transfer, letter of credit, or foreign remittance), with proceeds repatriated within 180 days. For the UN38.3 battery-safety and CE-RED electromagnetic testing lab: zero-rating is defensible where battery samples are imported into Vietnam under the temporary-import-for-re-export customs regime (or sourced from an EPE/free-trade zone), each sample batch is traced and either re-exported or destroyed under customs supervision, the test report is addressed exclusively to the offshore principal and used for UN38.3 certification outside Vietnam, and the testing fee is remitted in EUR/USD from abroad. Testing services physically performed in Vietnam for a domestic Vietnamese client, on goods released into the domestic market, or where the report is consumed in Vietnam are standard-rated at 10%; testing services are not within the 5% reduced-rate list. The GDT applies a substance-over-form review: paper exports with actual domestic consumption or deliberate mischaracterization of a domestic service as an offshore service will be re-rated at 10% and subject to penalties.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (electronic customs declaration with AR number) proving shipment, re-export, or in-bond temporary-import-for-re-export movement of the battery samples under customs supervision

Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / international transport document evidencing that the goods or tested samples left Vietnamese customs territory or were delivered under customs control to the foreign principal
Inward remittance certificate or bank credit advice from an authorized Vietnamese bank showing receipt of the export service fee in convertible foreign currency from abroad
Export or cross-border service contract between the VN LLC and the foreign client, identifying the UN38.3 / CE-RED testing scope, place of consumption, and payment terms
Commercial 0% VAT e-invoice issued to the foreign party, referencing the contract and describing the offshore testing service

Packing list, sample custody and logistics records, UN38.3 test report addressed to the foreign client, destruction certificate (if samples are destroyed under customs control), and other evidence of offshore consumption or use of the report
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are a priority audit area for the GDT and the General Department of Customs. Compliance expectations include a complete documentation trail, physical and accounting traceability of sample flows, proof of bank remittance from abroad, and evidence that the service was consumed offshore. Penalties for misstatement, circular round-tripping of funds, undisclosed domestic use of tested goods, or fabricated export documentation include: (1) reversal of the 0% rate and reassessment at the standard 10% VAT with late-payment interest at 0.03% per day from the original due date; (2) administrative fines of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax under Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14 Art. 17; (3) customs fines, confiscation, and tariff reassessment for false export declarations under Decree 128/2020/ND-CP; (4) extension of the tax assessment limitation period from 5 years to 10 years where evasion is established (Law on Tax Administration Art. 42); (5) suspension or denial of VAT refund claims for zero-rated exporters where the input VAT refund pattern shows no domestic output VAT, triggering pre-refund field audits; and (6) criminal prosecution under Penal Code Art. 200 for tax evasion, punishable by fines up to VND 4.5 billion and/or imprisonment of up to 7 years where the evaded amount exceeds statutory thresholds, with personal criminal liability for legal representatives and accountants who sign false export invoices.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) / Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam, acting through the Foreign Exchange Administration Department and the Credit Institutions Supervision Department, under the Government of Viet Nam. All cross-border foreign-exchange transactions, current-transfer procedures, capital-flow compliance, and licensed-bank FX operations are administered by the SBV under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange No. 06/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 as amended by Law No. 07/2013/QH13, and the implementing circulars of the SBV, principally Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam maintains current-account convertibility for service-export receipts and import payments: a UN38.3 battery-safety testing laboratory invoicing foreign clients can receive testing-fee income in freely convertible currencies through an SBV-licensed bank without an individual SBV conversion permit. Capital-account transactions are controlled and not freely convertible: foreign equity contributions must flow through a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at a licensed bank; foreign loans require debt-registration certificates under the SBV foreign-borrowing circulars; and profit remittance is classified as a current-account payment, but the remitting bank will require evidence that the LLC has prepared audited annual financial statements, fulfilled annual corporate income tax and value-added tax finalization obligations, and has no overdue tax liabilities. Practical convertibility hurdles are procedural rather than statutory: banks may request extensive underlying contracts, invoices, test certificates, and tax confirmation forms, and VND liquidity windows can create temporary conversion delays.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Viet Nam currently imposes a 0% mandatory currency conversion ratio for export/service receipts collected into an SBV-licensed bank; the LLC is not required to sell export proceeds to the bank and may retain foreign currency in its licensed foreign-currency account. The mandatory surrender obligation is replaced by a repatriation obligation: proceeds from supply of battery-safety testing services to overseas customers must be credited to a foreign-currency account at a licensed bank in Viet Nam within the statutory current-transaction repatriation period, commonly 90 days from the completion-of-services date evidenced by the test report and commercial invoice; if the funds are received into a permitted overseas account, they must be repatriated to the Vietnam bank account within 30 days of deposit. The LLC must maintain the signed service contract, commercial invoice, completed UN38.3 test report, customs or freight documents for battery samples, and a bank transaction declaration as supporting documents for the bank's review.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) as capital escrow account plus VND/USD operating settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA capital escrow account plus operational treasury account with multi-currency and trade-services window

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA capital account plus VND/USD operational account and import settlement account for laboratory equipment

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Technological and Joint Stock Commercial Bank (Techcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA capital account plus internet-banking-enabled operational settlement account
DICA capital account plus VND/USD current account for low-risk service-export flows

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB Bank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA capital account plus operational account and trade-finance facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs), including Wise, Airwallex, and Revolut, are not licensed as deposit-taking banks or payment-intermediary institutions in Viet Nam and cannot open local VND current accounts or provide primary treasury services for a Vietnamese LLC. Their practical viability is limited to auxiliary cross-border disbursement rails for low-value outbound payments, using the LLC's licensed-bank account to effect a VND-to-USD conversion and onward SWIFT/MT103 transfer to the EMI's partner bank in an originating jurisdiction. Such EMI arrangements are subject to increased compliance friction because the SBV does not classify non-bank EMIs as eligible accounts for capital-account or service-export treasury purposes, and the compliant documentary requirement remains the same as a bank wire. Overall feasibility rating: Low as a primary or exclusive treasury rail; acceptable as a secondary disbursement supplement only when commercial invoices, technical service agreements, and purpose codes are fully documented and when no foreign-currency collection on behalf of the LLC is routed through the EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory as a practical matter for the initial corporate account opening of a foreign-invested LLC: at least the legal representative and one authorized signatory must appear in person at the selected bank branch to present original passports or identity documents, sign KYC forms, provide specimen signatures, and be interviewed by the bank's compliance officer. Remote and fully digital account opening is generally not available for foreign-invested companies with cross-border ownership; the lack of an in-country office visit materially increases the probability of AML rejection or prolonged approval. The bank will require original Enterprise Registration Certificate, original Investment Registration Certificate, board resolution appointing the legal representative and signatories, UBO declarations, lease agreement for the laboratory premises, and evidence of the parent entity's corporate existence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital contribution above USD 500,000 or 15% of contributed capital made from a foreign parent jurisdiction with perceived low economic substance, tax-haven characteristics, or non-arms-length wiring patterns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), parent-company certificate of incorporation, corporate ownership and UBO diagram on a notarized board resolution, bank statements proving source of funds from the parent's active operating account, share-subscription or capital-contribution agreement, audited financial statements of the parent, and the DICA opening and credit statement from the licensed bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Testing-lab invoices to battery or electronics manufacturers located in jurisdictions subject to enhanced sanctions, OFAC lists, or SBV country-risk overrides, with inconsistent geographic customer profiles.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master testing agreements, inter-laboratory validation protocols, technical work orders, cross-referenced commercial invoices and POs, customs declarations, air-waybills or courier records evidencing physical movement of battery samples, ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation certificate, UN38.3 test methodology statement, and third-party sanctions screening reports confirming that the customer, all principals, and end consignees are not sanctioned parties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent intraday receipts of small foreign-currency testing fees with no clear link to a completed UN38.3 or CE-RED test protocol, and immediate conversion to VND for cash payroll.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UN38.3 drop-test/test-report register with unique test IDs, test-report-to-invoice cross-reference, payroll ledger, bank treasury policy, VAT and CIT filings, laboratory insurance certificates, and a written statement of fee calculation methodology for each battery type and testing tier.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concentrated UBO structure: one foreign director and one Vietnamese resident own 100% of the LLC but lack direct operational nexus, triggering request for personal tax identification numbers and physical operational evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of share issuance and UBO register, notarized lease contract of the laboratory premises, employee headcount list, dangerous-goods transport and storage permits, personal tax ID certificates, professional qualifications of the directors in battery safety testing, ISO/IEC 17025 quality manual, and the IRC/ERC evidencing the licensed testing scope.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export proceeds denominated in USD remitted through third-party payment service providers or an overseas account outside the licensed bank's direct reconciliation scope.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid contract clause requiring direct remittance to the LLC's DICA or operating account, the bank's cross-border transaction declaration form, SWIFT MT103 evidence, commercial invoice, completed test report, subcontractor or client side-letter confirming the payer is the final customer, and a written explanation of why a third-party payment intermediary was used if unavoidable.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant inbound capital routing is: (i) the foreign shareholder adopts a capital-contribution resolution and, if required under the IRC contribution schedule, notifies the Department of Planning and Investment of the exact contribution date and amount; (ii) the remitting bank executes a SWIFT MT103 wire from the parent's operating account to the LLC's DICA at the licensed Vietnamese bank, using the payment reference to include the IRC registration number and the phrase 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION TO DIRECT INVESTMENT ENTERPRISE'; (iii) the receiving bank verifies the wire against the IRC's contribution schedule, credits the DICA, and records it as foreign-investment capital; (iv) where funds are intended for treasury operations beyond registered capital, the shareholder may advance funds as a shareholder loan, which requires a foreign-loan registration certificate before disbursement; and (v) no SBV pre-approval is required for a straightforward cash equity contribution into the DICA, but the bank will require the shareholder and legal representative to complete a cross-border transaction declaration and maintain the full underlying legal file. The LLC's operating VND account should be funded by converting DICA foreign-currency balances into VND at the treasury desk or by separate remittances from service-export revenue.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound clearing for purchase of battery cells, calibration equipment, hazardous-goods packaging consumables, and subcontract laboratory services should be executed through the licensed bank using the following rails: (a) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer for routine payments under USD 100,000 per transaction, supported by purchase order, commercial invoice, and the underlying technical testing agreement; (b) Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700, UCP600) for high-value capital-equipment imports above USD 100,000, with inspection certificate and transport documents; (c) documentary collections (D/P or D/A) for established foreign calibration or equipment suppliers requiring documentary evidence of dispatch; and (d) inter-company subcontract settlements where the LLC and the foreign testing partner maintain a master services agreement, per-invoice statement of work, and evidence that the subcontracted UN38.3 testing step was actually performed. Each outward payment must be supported by the correct transaction purpose code, the LLC's enterprise tax identification number, and the invoice/report cross-reference file; the bank may require an audited internal authorization matrix to ensure that no single signatory controls both initiation and approval.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Foreign exchange forward contracts (USD/VND, USD/EUR, USD/JPY) with an SBV-licensed bank, executed only for documented underlying commercial transactions
Foreign exchange swaps (FX swaps) between USD and VND used for treasury liquidity management and short-term conversion risk
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) with licensed commercial banks for longer-dated liabilities, subject to SBV underlying-transaction verification
FX options, available only through licensed banks, used selectively to hedge contingent client testing-fee receipts where the underlying contract is firm and documentable

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department of the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 90th day after fiscal year-end; 31 March of the following year for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on unpaid CIT; administrative fine up to VND 25 million (approx. USD 1,000) for late filing; forced assessment and tax enforcement after repeated non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), and General Statistics Office (GSO)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from fiscal year-end; 31 March for calendar-year companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 10-30 million (approx. USD 400-1,200) under Decree 41/2022 for late submission or omission; CIT finalization dossier is incomplete without an audit report and may trigger additional tax assessment and penalization of under-declared tax.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Activity Report (Báo cáo hoạt động đầu tư)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) where the enterprise is registered
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 March of the calendar year following the reporting year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of VND 3-10 million (approx. USD 120-400) under Decree 122/2021 for late submission; false or omitted ownership information is fined VND 10-30 million; persistent non-filing may expose the project to inspection and eventual registration revocation under Decree 01/2021.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Tax Payment and Declaration (Lệ phí môn bài) - VND 2,000,000 tier for charter capital not exceeding VND 10 billion
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payment due by 30 January of each tax year; declaration within 30 days of establishment or charter-capital increase
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day and administrative fine up to VND 25 million (approx. USD 1,000) for failure to declare or pay under Decree 125/2020.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax (PIT) Finalization Return for Employees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 90th day after calendar year-end; 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to VND 25 million (approx. USD 1,000) for late filing; late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on under-remitted withholding tax.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Semi-Annual Labor Utilization Report (Báo cáo tình hình sử dụng lao động)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 5 June for first semester; 5 December for second semester
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of VND 1-3 million (approx. USD 40-120) per report under Decree 12/2022; repeated failure may delay labor-related administrative procedures and renewals.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent annual audit for all foreign-invested enterprises (FDI LLCs) regardless of size; compulsory also for parent companies preparing consolidated financial statements, public companies, credit institutions, insurance and securities undertakings, and domestic enterprises with annual revenue above VND 300 billion or total assets above VND 200 billion per Decree 174/2016 as amended by Decree 17/2023.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) under the Law on Accounting 2015; annual financial statements prepared in VND per Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; voluntary application of IFRS permitted only for consolidated statements of parent companies per Circular 21/2017/TT-BTC, while statutory standalone accounts must remain under VAS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam maintains no standalone UBO register and no separate annual UBO confirmation filing. Ownership confirmation is embedded in the Annual Foreign Investment Report filed with DPI by 31 March; any foreign shareholding transfer must be updated in the National Business Registration Database and reported to DPI within 10 days of the transfer. The Law on AML 2022 imposes beneficial-owner identification only on designated reporting entities, which does not apply to a standard UN38.3 testing laboratory LLC unless it becomes a regulated high-value reporting entity.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Sổ đăng ký thành viên)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400-1,200 per year for registered-address agent services, corporate secretarial filing support, and compliance monitoring by local service firms
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000-4,500 per year for an independent licensed audit firm, depending on transaction volume, headcount, and complexity of the testing laboratory

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard statutory CIT rate for a foreign-invested LLC performing UN38.3 and CE-RED laboratory services is 20%. No universal tax holiday applies; however, preferential 10% for 15 years is available for enterprises licensed as high-technology enterprises, established in eligible economic zones, hi-tech zones or industrial parks with supporting investment incentives, and to qualified small and medium enterprises after the new-investment grace period (CIT Law Art. 13-14, as amended; Decree 218/2013/ND-CP). Export Processing Enterprise (EPE) status may provide zero or postponed VAT treatment but does not by itself reduce CIT profit for domestic testing services. Losses carried forward for 5 years only; no carry-back.
